No child reserve is renewed. The incoming reference after b is the actual parent b-marginal; released old conditional KL is1-B_b. The new fresh-reference price Delta=1-mean B_a-J_b has complete net charge Delta-(1-B_b)=B_b-J_b-mean B_a<=B_b. Averaged fresh price is negative at L1 and strictly positive for every L>=2; for L>=16 it exceeds1/8bit. The constant x=b=1 terminal retains its full CE of1bit. The all-L tail spare exceeds8157/131072, using the same unused old1/16 reserve. This is a scoped inherited-bank payment, not a universal FEI bound.
